messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — I'm consolidating the postmortem follow-ups from Friday's regional failover into a single tracker. Need owners and short timelines so we can schedule a small tabletop drill. TL;DR: routing rule cleanup, nightly backup verification, restore runbook rewrite, and one focused drill.
Lucas K: I added an ownership column to the tracker and assigned tentative owners for routing cleanup. Can infra validate the test matrix? link: https://intra.redwood/trackers/dr-followups
Sanjay P: I can own the restore runbook rewrite. Proposal: draft updates by Wed EOD, tabletop drill Friday morning. @Maya R does that timeline work?
Maya R: Wed EOD for the runbook sounds fine. Planning note: drill should be 60m max and exercise both failover and restore paths.
Elaine T: I can coordinate the tabletop and recruit 2 SRE volunteers. Thursday 10:00 or Friday 09:00 — prefer Thu to get ahead of next week's deploys.
Grant H: Recommend adding an automated snapshot-verify job to nightly CI so backups are sanity-checked. Minimal change, catches bitrot.
Grant H: snippet for cron job:
```
# nightly snapshot check
0 3 * * * /usr/local/bin/snapshot-verify --region us-east-2 --report /tmp/snap-check.json
```
Lucas K: I'll take the routing test plan. Action: produce a small playbook that runs through BGP + edge route table failover scenarios. Target: Tue end of day for the test scripts.
Maya R: Ownership summary so far -> Routing tests: Lucas, Restore runbook: Sanjay, Tabletop coordination: Elaine, Backup automation: Grant. I'll add timelines to the tracker and tag owners.
ops-bot: Created issue #492 (dr-routing-test-plan) and issue #493 (restore-runbook-rewrite) in the incidents backlog.
Sanjay P: One ask — can devex provide a minimal checklist template for the runbook sections (restore, verification, rollback)? saves time.
devex-bot: Template uploaded -> /confluence/dr-templates/restore-checklist (permissions: team-read). :white_check_mark:
Elaine T: For the tabletop, request: 1) a reproducible seed (small traffic spike), 2) owner-run script for route flip, 3) pre-made incident channel. I can draft the scenario.
Maya R: Perfect. Please update the tracker with expected completion dates by EOD Tue. I will follow up in the weekly ops retro and propose we add this as a recurring quarterly drill. :thumbsup:
Lucas K: Added dates. Marked routing tests as "blocked" until infra validates permissions for route script.
Grant H: I'll put the snapshot-verify PR up today.
Maya R: Thanks all — will ping again after I merge the owner/timeline view. If anything changes tag @Maya R in the tracker rows. :spiral_notepad:
